prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Tobias Reyne for the job below.

About the freelancer: 7 years experience; skills: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, full stack, HTML and CSS

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: Create an online interactive spreadsheet
Build a web tool that allows users to create and manage online spreadsheets. Desired functionality includes: - Create a list from a file upload (typically .csv) - Scrape relevant data from uploaded list - Edit spreadsheets from the webpage - Create sub-lists from the primary spreadsheet
</job>

Past projects you may mention (the ONLY experience you may claim):
(none)

Style:
- Open with a generic line about being passionate and hard-working.
- Do not mention any specific past project or client.
- Prefer broad claims like 'extensive experience' over specifics.
- Write 300 to 380 words.

Output only the proposal text. Never add contact details or links.
text:
I’m a passionate and hard-working full-stack developer with 7 years of experience building modern web applications, and I’d love to help create your online interactive spreadsheet tool.

Your project is a strong fit for my background in JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API development, Tailwind CSS, and full stack web development. I can help design and build a clean, responsive interface where users can upload CSV files, generate lists from imported data, edit spreadsheet content directly in the browser, and organize that information into sub-lists from a primary spreadsheet.

I understand that this kind of tool needs to be both practical and easy to use. My focus would be on creating a smooth workflow from file upload through data processing and editing, while keeping the user experience simple and intuitive. I can also help structure the application so that the spreadsheet data is handled in a reliable way, with a backend that supports importing, transforming, and saving records efficiently.

For the data handling side, I would build the application so it can work well with uploaded CSV content and support extracting relevant information from the imported list. I can also implement the logic needed to create and manage sub-lists based on the main spreadsheet data, making it easier for users to organize and work with large sets of information.

On the frontend, I’d use React and Next.js to deliver a fast, responsive interface, with Tailwind CSS for a polished and consistent design. On the backend, Node.js and PostgreSQL would provide a solid foundation for storing and managing spreadsheet data, while REST APIs would connect the different parts of the tool cleanly.

I’m comfortable working across the full stack and focusing on both functionality and usability. If you’re looking for someone who can take this spreadsheet idea and turn it into a practical web tool, I’d be glad to discuss the details and help bring it to life.
